difficulty_reason: The author controls an arbitrary-order iterated Duhamel product after differentiation by isolating each potential slot, factoring one side into a Schatten operator and the rest into ordinary propagator bounds. The proof must choose intermediate admissible Sobolev exponents that close both sides of the differentiated slot, then transfer uniform bounds for arbitrary n,m to the density and its gradient using trace duality and an asymmetric density lemma. All of that authored multilinear operator core is retained rather than supplied as a black box; its combination of orthonormal Strichartz, time-ordered Schatten truncation and differentiated-slot exponents goes beyond ordinary qualification PDE estimates.
